name: Devasthanam Stay (Sita Nilayam, Rama Nilayam, and Ramadasu Choultry)
price: Non-AC rooms start around ₹250/night, and AC rooms up to ₹1,000/night
description: Temple Choultries & Rest Houses managed by the temple authority. Located within 200–500 meters of the temple. Bookings can be made via: Central Reception Office (Stay Enquiry): 08743-232467, Assistant EO Cell: +91 98667 70473, CRO Room Bookings: +91 80741 72638.

name: Haritha Hotel Bhadrachalam (Telangana Tourism)
price: Rooms range between ₹1,500 and ₹2,500/night depending on AC/Suite tiers
description: Located on Temple Road, opposite the Sub Collector Office (~1 km from the temple). Managed by TGTDC, it features standard AC/Non-AC rooms, family suites, and an on-site restaurant. Direct mobile: +91 98488 23073. Bookable via the Telangana Tourism Portal.

name: Varun Residency
description: Located ~210m from the temple entrance on Temple Road. Features 2-bed AC rooms, CCTV, hot water, and a lift.

name: Sri Bhavya Residency
description: Located on Medical Colony / Kalyanamandapam Road. Popular hotel with standard room amenities.

name: Gouthami Residency
description: Located on Temple Road, offering budget-friendly rooms.

name: Laxmi Venkateswara Hotel
description: Located on Temple Road near the Police Station. Budget lodge with standard and deluxe suites.

name: Arya Vysya Nityannadana Satram
description: Located in Medical Colony. Community-run sathram providing simple lodging and free traditional meals.
